01 / About me

Order gives records
their value.

A historian by education, an archivist by practice, and someone who believes good documentation makes knowledge easier to preserve and use.

I graduated with a Bachelor’s degree in History from Universitas Sebelas Maret, graduating cum laude with a GPA of 3.70/4.00. My academic training taught me to read sources critically, understand context, and pay attention to the details behind every record.

During my internship at PT PLN (Persero), I worked with historical corporate archives, including Dutch-language documents connected to company assets, concessions, and nationalisation. I enjoy work that calls for patience, accuracy, and a clear system.

“An archive is more than a collection of documents. It is evidence, context, and institutional memory.”

02 / Professional experience

From historical sources
to usable records.

Practical experience in archival research, classification, cataloguing, and documentation within a corporate archive environment.

March – June 2025 · Internship

PT PLN (Persero) — Corporate Archive Management

Head Office · Jakarta, Indonesia
  • Inventoried and documented historical corporate archives using spreadsheets to support retrieval and information tracking.
  • Prepared metadata and document catalogues based on document details, categories, and relevant periods.
  • Classified archival materials and checked the completeness and consistency of document information.
  • Translated historical Dutch-language records into Indonesian and prepared summaries of asset-related information.
  • Conducted archival source research through Indonesia’s National Archives (ANRI), locating more than 150 relevant Besluit documents during the project.
  • Supported archival documentation and information management in coordination with the supervising team.

Project documentation is selectively displayed to respect internal company information and asset confidentiality.
